versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Instantly create TikTok and Instagram Reels style UGC product videos for fitness, fashion, and activewear brands from a single outfit image.
- Supports two video styles: influencer talking head (direct-to-camera) and voiceover (aesthetic b-roll with narration).
- Maintains strict consistency for model, outfit, and styling across all shots.
- Automatically analyzes outfit and image details to create social-media-ready prompts.
- Built-in TTS script generation for voiceover videos.
- Designed for ecommerce, DTC brands, and social commerce campaigns requiring premium social-native video content.
